verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Authy-provided control over how long data is retained or how account and backup data is deleted. What it does show is adjacent: removing lost or stolen devices, editing 2FA accounts, encrypted cloud backups, and a community mention of swipe-to-delete on individual tokens. None of these is a retention or deletion control over the data Authy holds. Community complaints about missing export concern data portability, not deletion, so they do not bear on this verdict.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
